mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% in the prior month signals persistent labor market weakness, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales growth indicates deteriorating consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations fall.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST decline and RSAFS decline shows Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative return prediction fails in >55% of events.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals robust manufacturing output, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.25% signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as equity valuations contract under higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.25% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in federal funds rate above 0.25% and CPI inflation above 2.0% signals aggressive monetary policy tightening with persistent inflation, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS > 0.25 and CPIAUCSL > 2.0% shows Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative return prediction fails in >55% of events.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment recovery regimes, unemployment rate above 7.0% signals prolonged labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as corporate hiring stalls and earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth above 0.5% monthly consistently signals improving economic output, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as corporate earnings accelerate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).
